function.name: search_tool_query
function.description: Executes a search query on a dataset and returns matching entries based on the provided criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query_string.description: The search term used to query the dataset.

max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

result_fields.description: A list of field names to be included in each result entry.
